title.zh: 法律专业（规定费用）规则 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Legal Profession (Prescribed Fees) Rules 2024 and come into operation on 2 December 2024.
2. The fees specified in the second column of the Schedule are payable in respect of the matters under the provisions of the Act as specified opposite in the first column of that Schedule.
3. Revoke the Legal Profession (Prescribed Fees) Rules (R 12).

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 2
Fees
First column
Second column
1.Instrument of admission as lawyer (NP) under section 11D(3)
$100
2.Certificate to practise (pursuant to an ad hoc admission) under section 15(7)
$1,000
3.Instrument of admission as advocate and solicitor under section 16(3)
$100
4.Provisional practising certificate under section 18(3)(b) applied for in paper
$100
5.Provisional practising certificate under section 18(3)(b) applied for by electronic means
$85
6.Practising certificate under section 25(1)(e) applied for in paper
$100
7.Practising certificate under section 25(1)(e) applied for by electronic means
$85
